meta.name: paid-ads-chatgpt
meta.description: Plan and review ChatGPT Ads experiments without assuming ad inventory, account access, or platform capabilities. Use for ChatGPT advertising, OpenAI ads, conversational ad concepts, ChatGPT campaign plans, or performance reviews from a verified export.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在投放ChatGPT广告
copy.tagline_en: Plan and evaluate ChatGPT ad experiments
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're planning ChatGPT ad campaigns

howto.what: 装上后,Claude会帮你规划ChatGPT广告实验:先明确目标、预算、受众,再生成一份待审核的测试简报,包含假设、停止条件等。它不会编造广告位或数据,还会提示你缺少哪些账户权限。
howto.when: 当你说到“ChatGPT广告”“OpenAI广告”“对话式广告概念”等词,或要求规划广告实验、审查导出数据时,它会接管。

say.text: 帮我规划一个ChatGPT广告实验,目标获客。
say.note: 会生成带预算和停止条件的测试简报。

say.text: 这是我们的广告导出文件,请审查表现。
say.note: 只基于导出内容分析,不虚构数据。

say.text: 假设我们只有对话式广告位,能做什么?
say.note: 会提醒缺少的访问权限,不假设库存。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude will help plan ChatGPT Ads experiments: it clarifies goals, budget, audience, then produces a test brief for review with hypothesis and stop conditions. It will not invent ad inventory or performance data, and will flag missing account access.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention ChatGPT advertising, OpenAI ads, conversational ad concepts, or ask to plan a campaign or review an export.

say_en.text: Help me plan a ChatGPT Ads experiment focused on acquisition.
say_en.note: Produces a test brief with budget and stop conditions.

say_en.text: Here is our ad export file; please review performance.
say_en.note: Analyzes only the export, never fabricates data.

say_en.text: What can we do assuming only conversational ad slots?
say_en.note: Will note missing access and avoid assuming inventory.
